# Headers and cookies

Generated from the source by `scripts/gen-reference.mjs`; do not edit by hand.

## Default security headers

`nowaki dev`, `nowaki start` and the adapter outputs add these to every response that doesn't set them already (ISR hits and static files included). `NOWAKI_SECURITY_HEADERS=off` removes them all. A `headers` rule in nowaki.config with the same name replaces one.

| Header | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `x-content-type-options` | `nosniff` |
| `x-frame-options` | `SAMEORIGIN` |
| `referrer-policy` | `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` |
| `cross-origin-opener-policy` | `same-origin` |
| `content-security-policy` | `frame-ancestors 'self'`, only when the response has no CSP (neither the app's nor `NOWAKI_CSP`'s) |

## Content Security Policy

Off by default. `NOWAKI_CSP=report-only` sends `Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only`, `NOWAKI_CSP=enforce` sends `Content-Security-Policy`, with this policy (`<nonce>` is new for every response; `NOWAKI_CSP_REPORT_URI` appends `; report-uri <uri>`):

```text
default-src 'self';
script-src 'self' 'nonce-<nonce>';
style-src-elem 'self' 'nonce-<nonce>';
style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline';
img-src 'self' data:;
font-src 'self' data:;
connect-src 'self';
object-src 'none';
base-uri 'self';
form-action 'self';
frame-ancestors 'self'
```

The nonce goes on the scripts and styles Nowaki emits and on tags that carry `nonce()` ([runtime.md](runtime.md#nonce)); inline scripts and styles that reach the page as raw HTML get none. A response that sets its own CSP is left alone. Static output (`nowaki prerender`) has no per-response nonce.

## Cache headers

- An ISR page (`export const revalidate = n`) sends `Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=<n>, stale-while-revalidate`, with `Vary` naming the request headers the render read. A render that read cookies or `Authorization` sends `Cache-Control: private, no-cache` instead.
- A response that sets a cookie never gets a shared `Cache-Control`: `public` / `s-maxage` become `private, no-cache`.
- `GET /__nowaki/health` sends `Cache-Control: no-store`.

## Response headers

| Header | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `x-nowaki-cache` | Response header of `nowaki start` on ISR pages: `HIT` (served from the cache), `STALE` (served from the cache while a re-render runs) or `MISS` (rendered for this request). |

## Cookies

| Cookie | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `nowaki_locale` | The visitor's locale choice with `i18n.detect`: set by `setLocale()` (and a `<Link locale>` click in an island) with `Path` = basePath, one year, `SameSite=Lax`. A request to the site's root follows it before `Accept-Language`. |
| `nowaki_session` | The default `ctx.session` cookie name (`cookieName` in session.ts changes it). `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Secure` on HTTPS, `Path` = basePath. Encrypted (cookie store) or a signed id (with a `store`). |

## Not covered

The other `x-nowaki-*` headers (the ones the client runtime sends, and the ones Nowaki's processes use among themselves) may change in any release: `x-nowaki-cc`, `x-nowaki-csp-marker`, `x-nowaki-intercept`, `x-nowaki-live`, `x-nowaki-nav`, `x-nowaki-page`, `x-nowaki-purge`, `x-nowaki-revalidate`, `x-nowaki-route`, `x-nowaki-route-path`, `x-nowaki-rpc`, `x-nowaki-slot`, `x-nowaki-ssr-version`, `x-nowaki-stored`, `x-nowaki-stub`, `x-nowaki-tags`, `x-nowaki-vary`, `x-nowaki-vary-out`, `x-nowaki-vary-query`.
